The name sevelamer has been used for both sevelamer and sevelamer hydrochloride. Adverse Effects and Precautions The most common adverse effects associated with sevelamer are diarrhoea, nausea and vomiting, consti- pation, headache, cough and other respiratory symp- toms, dizziness, hypotension or hypertension, periph- eral oedema, pain, and fever.
